commands.name: intakeOn
commands.summary: Runs the front intake inward and keeps it running. The state parameter has one value and a default, so an auto calls intakeOn with no arguments; it tells Zenith's intake checks that this command runs the intake.

commands.name: intakeOff
commands.summary: Stops the front intake. Like intakeOn, it takes no arguments in an auto.

commands.name: spinUp
commands.summary: Brings the launcher up to speed so the next score starts sooner. Ends once the launcher is at speed.

commands.name: score
commands.summary: Launches count pollen into the alliance's up hive cell, then waits for the launcher to settle. The robot must stand still while it runs.

conditions.name: holdingPiece
conditions.summary: At least one pollen is aboard. A sensor in the intake reads it.

conditions.name: hopperFull
conditions.summary: The robot holds as much pollen as it may: four in BIOBUZZ.
